I have 50 mu here in Quzhou. That is a good-sized piece of land — bigger than most in my village — so I have to think about my whole budget. I cannot afford a bad year. Seven people live in my house, so I have family labor, but for the big jobs I still hire machines.

My main field is 28 mu of wheat-maize rotation. That is my foundation. For wheat, I plant Luyuan 502, the improved variety. Last year I got about 1000 jin per mu, around 500 kg. I will do rotary tillage first, then put down one bag — 50 kg — of compound fertilizer per mu as basal. Then at green-up and jointing I topdress with urea. All together that is about 22 kg of nitrogen, 9 kg of phosphorus, and 8 kg of potassium per mu. I irrigate three times from my well: once in winter, once at jointing, and once at flowering. For sprays, I do herbicide once after sowing, insecticide twice, and fungicide once for rust — four times total. I would rather spend the money on fertilizer than risk losing yield.

For summer maize, I plant Denghai 605 hybrid right after wheat harvest. The window is tight, so I mostly do no-tillage — just plant into the wheat stubble. I put about 40 kg of compound fertilizer per mu, then topdress once. That works out to about 20 kg nitrogen, 7 kg phosphorus, and 6 kg potassium per mu. Two irrigations, three sprays. I expect around 550 kg per mu.

I also have 6 mu of garlic. I plant Hongshuan garlic now in autumn. Garlic needs more fertilizer — I use about 75 kg of compound plus extra urea and some potash, around 28 kg nitrogen, 12 kg phosphorus, and 16 kg potassium per mu. Four irrigations, three sprays. Should get 1500 kg per mu.

My cabbage is 5 mu, autumn crop on the side plot. I plant Zhonggan 56 hybrid. About 25 kg nitrogen, 10 kg phosphorus, 12 kg potassium per mu. Water four times, spray five times. Hope for 4000 kg per mu.

Chili is 4 mu, planted in spring. Zhinong improved variety. Chili gets aphids and viruses easily, so I spray a lot — maybe 12 times. Fertilizer is about 22 kg nitrogen, 8 kg phosphorus, 12 kg potassium per mu. Water four times. If the weather is good, 2500 kg per mu.

Onion is 4 mu, spring planted. Similar to garlic for feeding: about 25 kg nitrogen, 10 kg phosphorus, 14 kg potassium per mu. Four irrigations, four sprays. Can get 7000 kg per mu.

Stevia is 3 mu. I planted Chengguang stevia last year, it is perennial. I just maintain it now — about 16 kg nitrogen, 6 kg phosphorus, 8 kg potassium per mu. Water five times, spray eight times for bugs. Dried leaves, about 280 kg per mu.

I watch what the other big farms around me do. Last year worked fine, so I am not changing much. Change is risky. A bad harvest means I lose real money. Wasting some fertilizer is just a cost I accept.
